title: IASc Annual Meeting Outreach, IISER Tirupati
teaser: Outreach activities at IISER Tirupati during the Indian Academy of Sciences 91st Annual Meeting, 14–15 November 2025.
homepageMatter: tAcT outreach activities were held at IISER Tirupati, Tirupati, during the Indian Academy of Sciences 91st Annual Meeting on 14–15 November 2025. The Annual Meeting hosted a public lecture by Shivkumar Kalyanaraman (CEO, ANRF) on AI for science and engineering.
